notes.subject: ללוא שאלו
notes.rationale: Passive Niphal 1cs: 'I was sought by those who asked not' vs active 'I sought those who asked not' (LXX/NT Rom 10:20 reading).

notes.subject: הנני הנני
notes.rationale: Doubled hinenni — 'lukluk, mi stap, lukluk, mi stap' — repetition kept to carry Yahwe's eager self-offering.

notes.subject: verse
notes.rationale: Yahwe reveals himself unbidden to those who did not seek him — the unexpected, withheld-now-given disclosure.

translation: Ol i bin askim long mi, taim ol i no bin askim; ol i bin painim mi, taim ol i no bin lukluk long mi. Mi tok: Lukluk, mi stap, lukluk, mi stap, long wanpela lain i no bin singautim nem bilong mi.
